about.title: About
about.missionBody: To show the world the daily life, the stories, the cultures and the traditions of African villages — filmed where they happen, told by the people who live them.
about.visionBody: To build a bridge between African village communities and an international audience, without turning either one into a postcard.
about.howBody: We film in one region at a time and we go back. We name the people who want to be named, we situate every village, and we never present an invented image as a real report.

partners.title: Partners
partners.lead: Would you like to work with Afro Daily Village?
partners.body: We work with brands, institutions, tourism boards, production companies and media outlets — as long as the result is something we would have been proud to film anyway.
partners.sponsoringBody: Clearly labelled sponsored films and articles. Labelled means labelled.
partners.advertisingBody: Display placements that never cover the text and never open by themselves.
partners.productionBody: Filming on commission in the region, with local crews.
partners.mediaBody: Footage licensing and co-productions with other outlets.

support.title: Support us

support.body: The most useful thing you can do costs nothing: subscribe, watch to the end, and send one film to one person who would not have found it. If you want to do more, the ways to give will be listed here.
